title: Cursor Plus Is $8. Grok Only.
caption:
Cursor's cheapest paid plan is $8 now and it can't run Claude at all.

I only checked because I assumed cheaper was just cheaper. On the new tiers the Grok models come out of one weekly pool, and Claude, GPT and Gemini bill at API list price from prepaid credit — Premium and up only.

I'm still on the legacy plan and I'm not switching until someone shows me the math.

Still on your old plan?
